info.name: OPD Wallet API — web-angular member
info.description:
Scoped to the routes \web-angular\projects\member\src\app\core is seen to call. Recovered by scanning source for request paths, so it is a lower bound: a path assembled at runtime from a variable does not appear here.

Generated from http://localhost:4000/api/docs-json — do not hand-edit, it is overwritten on regeneration.

Auth: httpOnly `opd_session` cookie. Log in via the auth folder first; Postman's cookie jar carries it to every other request.

23 descriptions authored via @ApiOperation, 100 derived from handler names and marked as such.
